profile.headline: Senior Data Scientist and ML Engineer
profile.short_tagline: I build probabilistic machine learning systems and own them in production: freight pricing, delivery-time prediction, and demand forecasting for logistics companies. Lately I also build the agentic tooling that helps data science teams ship.
profile.current_role: Currently a Senior Data Scientist at Arrive Logistics in Chicago, working on quantile pricing for truckload freight.
profile.availability: I'm open to senior IC roles in applied ML, data, and AI engineering, and to scoped consulting work.

about: I'm a data scientist and ML engineer with over ten years in logistics. At Coyote Logistics I worked on real-time freight pricing and load matching. At ShipBob I owned the ML platform behind demand forecasting, delivery-time prediction, and inventory planning. Today I work on truckload pricing at Arrive Logistics.

Most of my work is probabilistic: quantile regression, conformal calibration, and forecasting at scale, plus the backtests and simulations that show a model is better before it ships. I take models the whole way, from SQL and feature pipelines to FastAPI services, Docker, and the apps people use to make decisions.
Outside work I build complete products on the same stack, from open-source forecasting benchmarks to a live crypto research app and a sports data platform behind several deployed apps.
